content:
q17. web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; memoServiceClient

This hook (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`) implements the memo CRUD operations — `listMemos`, `getMemo`, `createMemo`, `updateMemo`, `deleteMemo`, plus comment listing — and calls them all through `memoServiceClient` (imported from `web/src/connect.ts:5`). That client is the generated Connect-RPC client built from the `MemoService` proto definition: `web/src/connect.ts:197` does `export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`, where `MemoService` comes from the generated `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:10`.
